70:1: A questioner asked about a punishment to occur.
70:2: For the disbelievers, there is none to prevent it.
70:3: From Allah, the Owner of the stairs.
70:4: The angels and the spirit ascend to Him in a day whose measure is fifty thousand years.
70:5: So be patient with a beautiful patience.
70:6: Indeed, they see it as far off.
70:7: And We see it as near.
70:8: On that day the sky will be like molten metal.
70:9: And the mountains will be like wool.
70:10: And a friend will not ask after a friend.
70:11: They will be shown to one another; the guilty one wishes to ransom himself from the punishment of that day with his sons,
70:12: And his spouse and his brother,
70:13: And his clan that shelters him,
70:14: And all who are on the earth, then it saves you.
70:15: No, never! Indeed, it is a blazing fire,
70:17: Calling whoever turned his back and turned away,
70:18: And gathered wealth and hoarded it.
70:19: Indeed, man has been created impatient.
70:20: When evil touches him, he becomes anxious.
70:21: And when good touches him, he withholds.
70:23: Those who are constant in their prayers,
70:24: And those in whose wealth is a determined right for the beggar and the poor,
70:25: For the petitioner and the deprived,
70:26: And those who affirm the Day of Judgment,
70:27: And those who are fearful of the punishment of their Rabb,
70:28: Indeed, from the punishment of their Rabb none is secure,
70:29: And those who guard their chastity,
70:30: Except from their spouses and what they possess, for indeed they are not blameworthy.
70:31: Whoever seeks beyond this, then it is they who are the transgressors,
70:32: And those who observe their trusts and their covenants,
70:33: And those who stand firm in their testimonies,
70:34: And those who guard their prayers,
70:35: Those will be honored in gardens.
70:36: What is the matter with those who disbelieve, that they rush toward you?
70:37: Regarding those rushing toward you, from the right and from the left in groups.
70:38: Does every person among them hope to be entered into a garden of delight?
70:39: No, never! Indeed, We created them from what they know.
70:40: No, I swear by the Rabb of the easts and the wests, indeed We are surely capable,
70:41: To replace them with better than them, and We cannot be outrun.
70:42: Leave them to plunge into falsehood and play until they meet their day which they are promised,
70:43: That day they will emerge from the graves rapidly, as if they were rushing to a target,
70:44: Their eyes cast down, humiliation covering them; that is the day which they were promised.
